user.title: Nexus Controller
user.description: Positive phase power means grid import; negative means export. Battery commands are not active in this version.

data.grid_power_l1_entity: Net power phase L1 sensor (W; positive import, negative export)

data.battery_power_entity: Battery net power sensor (W; positive discharges, negative charges; needed for the shadow proposal, optional)
data.charge_price_below: Charge from the grid when the price is at most (EUR/kWh)
data.discharge_price_above: Cover consumption from the battery when the price is at least (EUR/kWh)
data.min_margin_eur_kwh: Minimum net gain per kWh before trading (EUR/kWh)
